name: Web document — Hacker News (horizontal)
description: A recognizable Hacker News thread on a transparent overlay, as a clean backdrop for the channel's hand-pulled highlight. Faithful site look BY DESIGN: HN's light beige page (#f6f6ef) under the orange masthead, the Y logo + nav, a comment with its vote arrow + 'username Nh ago' meta in small Verdana, inside a browser window whose address bar shows the URL — NO Syntax collage chrome (no torn edge / grit / hard offset shadow), and NO CSS glow on the captured card. Because the page is light, the highlight runs in the light (multiply) blend mode — the dark comment text stays readable under the amber band, like on paper. The emissive 'web page on a backlit display' look is a TypeGPU shaderPass (subpixel emission, backlight bloom, escaping-bezel halo, viewport-edge defocus), not Pack chrome. ~6s: card settles in, the highlighter draws over the hero line (~1.2→2.4s), then a long static hold a creator can freeze/extend. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.

content.title: Show HN: I shaved 40s off our build by deleting one line
content.body: We'd been blaming the bundler for months. Profiled it properly and [highlight]the entire slowdown was a console.log inside a hot loop[/highlight] that ran for every module. Deleted one line and the build went from 41s to 9s. Measure before you optimize, every time.
